d:
What I brought with my girlfriend was an island where girls live naked.

What was taken without knowing was an unexplored area known to those who knew - the island of the female body
I can not hide my surprise at the female friend who stepped on the island and suddenly took off, but what you can see is a beautiful woman body
The naked bodies of the women who are guided as they are washed away and captured on camera ...
But what was beyond that was a harem-like festival by the women of the island...
